Kling 4.0 image-to-video just did something I didn't expect. I started from a single still of this character, and the red threads actually behave like threads, pulling tight between her fingers and weaving into that star shape instead of turning into a smeary mess.

What got me most was the camera work in the last few seconds. It pushes into her palm, the focus shifts naturally, and the coins swing across the frame with real motion blur. Her face and the detail in her robe stay consistent through all of it, which is usually where image-to-video falls apart for me.

This is the first time I've gotten a shot with this much intent from a still image without a pile of retries. @Kling_ai 4.0 is worth trying if you care about cinematic movement.
